description: OPT-IN: fetch an article from an OLD / REPEALED Romanian law (e.g. the former Cod fiscal, Legea 571/2003, for a dispute over a pre-2016 transaction). Unlike lookup_article, this is NOT restricted to in-force acts, so it can return abrogated text (tagged [ABROGATED]). Use ONLY when you deliberately need historical/repealed law — the normal tools return current law only.

law.description: The act, however it is at hand: a citation ('Legea 265/2022', 'HG 1/2016', 'Ordinul 2594/C/2008'), a common name ('Codul fiscal'), a title any tool printed, or 'normele de aplicare a Legii X'.

name: lookup_article_historical
